validation.name: Enter a name
validation.regexLength: Expression too long (200 characters at most)
validation.bounds: Enter at least one valid amount
validation.order: The minimum is above the maximum

sentence.empty: Pick at least one part of the transaction.

picker.title: From the transaction
picker.hint: Tap the parts that must always be there. The rest is ignored.
picker.variableHint: Words with numbers change on every transaction, so the rule skips them.

impact.title: Affected transactions
impact.error: We couldn't work out the impact.
impact.truncated: Worked out on the most recent transactions.
impact.warnBroad: This would take {{count}} transactions out of other categories, more than the ones already right. Add a part to narrow the rule.
impact.warnConflict_one: It would also catch {{count}} transaction that already has another category (even one you chose). The rule is too generic to tell it apart.
impact.warnConflict_other: It would also catch {{count}} transactions that already have another category (even ones you chose). The rule is too generic to tell them apart.
impact.protectedHint: Corrections you made by hand always win over rules.
impact.needCategory: Pick the category to see how many transactions it would affect.

customize.title: Conditions
customize.amountHint: The amount is compared without sign: a −487.30 payment counts as 487.30.
customize.regexHint: Regular expression: only for cases the other choices don't cover.
customize.nameHint: Leave it empty and I'll pick one.

apply.label_one: Also apply to the existing transaction
apply.label_other: Also apply to the {{count}} existing transactions
apply.hint: Transactions you corrected by hand are never touched.
apply.later: Rule created. It applies to transactions that arrive from now on: existing ones were not changed (transactions you chose by hand are never touched).
apply.started: Rule created. Updating the transactions now: follow it in Activity.
apply.busy: Rule created. Another reclassification is running: apply the rule to existing transactions when it finishes.
apply.failed: Rule created, but we couldn't update the existing transactions.

suggestions.ambiguous: Transactions with this text have different categories: the payee or the reason tells them apart.
suggestions.question: Which transactions should this always apply to?
